prompt: Challenge C144-CH2: Downstream purification — specifically the ultrafiltration step — runs at only 55% of nominal throughput because the membranes foul with res

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Cross-flow ultrafiltration systems using spiral-wound polyethersulfone membranes experience irreversible fouling after 8 hours, with permeate flux declining by 65–80% within the first 30 minutes of operation depending on membrane type and conditions.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07419","field":"abstract","quote":"Irreversible fouling after 8 h was quantified at 18 % flux loss"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-07415","field":"abstract","quote":"Permeate flux declined by 65–80 % within the first 30 min of operation"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Resistance-in-series analysis attributed 55% of total resistance to reversible concentration polarisation and 45% to irreversible fouling, and the critical flux concept was applied to map stable operating windows for membrane operation.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07415","field":"abstract","quote":"Resistance-in-series analysis attributed 55 % of total resistance to reversible concentration polarisation and 45 % to irreversible fouling"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-07415","field":"abstract","quote":"The critical flux concept was applied to map stable operating windows"}]}]}
